entries.title: GitHub pull requests carry the same evidence as their merge cards
entries.body: New GitHub pull requests and their merge cards share one explanation, with the same pictures and recordings. Infinitary confirms every upload before opening the pull request, reuses confirmed uploads after a restart, and preserves text you add around its description. Pictures can sit side by side; recordings appear one below another so both stay visible.
entries.noPicture: The story spans GitHub and the app; one app picture cannot demonstrate that they share the same evidence.
